title: Magnetism
description: Adds the ability to create working magnets to Minecraft
body:
# Magnetism

Magnetism is a datapack that adds magnetic mechanics to Minecraft.
With just lodestones, lightning rods, and a storm, you can unlock the power of magnetism!

### 🧲 Magnet Block
-   Place a lodestone and put a lightning rod on top.
-   During a thunderstorm, if lightning strikes the rod, the block becomes magnetic.
-   By default, it attracts players, but each additional lightning strike switches its 
   polarity between attraction and repulsion.
-   Magnetic strength increases if the player is wearing any piece of iron armor, or if 
  holding an iron block in hand.

### 🚀 Hyperloop

Build a magnetic ring for ultra-fast travel! To create it:
1. Choose a center point.
2. Move 3 blocks away in all four directions.
3. On the 4th block in each direction, place a Magnet Block.


- If built correctly, the structure forms a Hyperloop.

- Walking through the ring will launch you with strong directional force!

⚠️ This is an early beta release, expect bugs and balancing changes.
